prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Americium (Am) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a hilltop observatory with its dome open to a clear night sky, a brass-railed platform around the great telescope
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: short denim dungarees over a bandeau top, one strap unhooked, canvas sneakers; right now — one strap — or one side of the neckline — has slipped down off her shoulder, baring that whole shoulder and the top of her arm; she leaves it as it is, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on one knee, the other foot planted flat in front of her.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small round white smoke detector with a tiny steady red light at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — americium: a soft silvery synthetic metal first identified in late 1944, born on its own as plutonium-241 decays, and named for the Americas just as europium above it was named for Europe; a speck smaller than a grain of dust sits inside household smoke detectors, gently ionizing the air between two plates, and when smoke drifts in it notices and sounds the alarm; with a half-life of 432 years it is a tiny lamp that stays awake while everyone sleeps — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
